chatbot.name: ForgeHub Feature Tour
chatbot.description: Walks through every FlowForge question type, template kind, entity operation, and logic step. Import from Chatbots → Import.

globals.description: Shown in templates and the recap email
Name used in the welcome template before we ask
Choices for the autocomplete city question

config.prompt: Quick human check before we start.
Please confirm you are running a demonstration and will not enter real secrets.
config.confirmLabel: I agree — this is a demo

config.text: First, identity and contact — name, email, phone, address, ID, and a few extras.

config.prompt: What is your full name?
What should I call you? (short text)
Write a short bio (optional long text).
What is your email address?
What is your phone number?
Enter a demo password (masked in chat — do not use a real one).
Enter a national ID or similar number (6–16 digits). Switch the question to South African format if you want the 13-digit checksum.
How do you describe your gender?
Which country are you in?
What is your street / mailing address?
Postal / ZIP code (digits).
Personal or company URL (optional).
Pick a favourite colour.

config.text: Dates, times, an appointment, and an optional GPS location.

config.prompt: What is your date of birth?
What time of day works best for a callback?
Pick a date and time for a follow-up.
Book a studio appointment (date + time).
Share a location (browser GPS) if you want — optional.

config.text: Every numeric and sentiment control: yes/no, thumbs, mood, Likert, ratings, sliders, money.

config.prompt: Should we email you a recap after the tour?
Thumbs up or down on this tour so far?
How are you feeling about FlowForge?
“The designer is easy to follow.”
Rate the welcome copy from 1–5.
Star rating for the overall product.
How likely are you to recommend FlowForge? (0–10)
How much effort did this take so far?
How confident are you that you will finish the tour?
How many people are in your party? (+ / −)
Demo budget in ZAR (not charged).
How many chatbots do you plan to build? (number)

config.text: Lists, autocomplete, ranking, a matrix, and picture cards.

config.prompt: Which areas do you care about? (multi-select)
Search and pick a city.
Rank these priorities (drag to reorder).
Rate each row on the same scale.
Pick a look (upload look_studio.png and look_garden.png to the Media library, or skip if those files are missing).

config.text: Uploads, signature, voice note, OTP, and a multi-field form.

config.prompt: Upload a sample image or PDF (optional).
Draw your signature — we will stamp it on the visit pack PDF.
Record a short voice note if you want (optional; times out after 45s).
Enter a 6-digit demo PIN (format-only unless you bind an email connection).
Company details on one screen (stored as a single object).

config.text: Next is the store catalog (Templates → Store catalog). Add items, checkout, then pay the cart total — that is product subtotal plus shipping and VAT.

config.prompt: Browse the ForgeHub catalog and checkout.
Pay {{vars.cart.total}} {{vars.cart.currency}} (self-confirm in Preview, or bind a Payment connection).

config.text: NPS {{vars.nps}} — thank you, {{vars.nickname}}. You are a promoter. Uppercase name: {{vars.full_name_upper}}.
NPS {{vars.nps}} — thanks for the honest score, {{vars.nickname}}. We will keep building.

config.message: Done, {{vars.full_name}}. You used every question type, all template kinds, entities, a condition, a loop, operations, HTTP, and email. Bind connections on Data if you want live HTTP, SMTP, OTP, or PayFast.

items.question: What is this chatbot?
items.answer: A single flow that uses every question type, template kind, and data step FlowForge ships.

items.question: Do I need connections?
items.answer: HTTP, email, OTP delivery, and PayFast confirmation are optional. Without them those steps are mocked or self-confirmed in Preview.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: Answers land in variables. Near the end, an Entity step writes a Visits record you can inspect on the Data tab.
